blurb: Cantigny Golf Youth Links is a 9-hole golf course designed for youth players, part of the larger Cantigny Park which includes gardens, a museum, and other recreational activities. The park offers various events and programs throughout the year. The Youth Links is part of the Cantigny Golf complex designed by Roger Packard and opened in 1989.
